description: This Java class defines a command for modifying a Resource within a Policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, getters for its fields, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ModifyResource
classes.description: A final immutable command class in the Ditto framework that modifies a Resource within a Policy, including JSON serialization/deserialization and relevant metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ModifyResource command instance from explicit parameters including PolicyId, Label, Resource, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyResource command instance from a JSON string or JsonObject, parsing required fields.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource object to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the Policy associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the resource to JSON according to the schema version if applicable.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource within the policy structure.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including policy ID, label, resource key, and resource JSON.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyResource with the specified headers.
